The simulation uses pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar flow past a cylinder on a one-cell-thick 2D mesh.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, the frontAndBack patches are defined with type empty.
In 0/U, the frontAndBack boundary condition is set to type empty.
The inlet, outlet, and cylinderWall patches retain their standard flow-past-cylinder boundary conditions and are not modified.
No wall or symmetryPlane condition is applied to the frontAndBack patches.
The empty type indicates that no computation is performed across the front-and-back faces, consistent with the one-cell-thick 2D mesh topology.
